name: Yellow clam and white clam
summary: Ngao vàng and ngao trắng are the yellow clam and the white clam, sold apart from ngao Phù Long.
howToEat: Order them by weight. Ngao vàng is also sold by the piece. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
seoTitle: Ngao vàng and ngao trắng on Cat Ba
